info.title: Fountain Coach FCIS — Standalone Go HTTP API
info.description: Canonical FCIS-owned OpenAPI 3.1 contract, peer to FCIS-STACK.md in the Fountain-Coach/.github organization root. Describes the proposed standalone Go HTTPS/OAuth/WebAuthn/MCP/Host HTTP protocol and inherited owner/machine administration shapes. All operations are target specifications, not evidence of a deployed or callable Go service; runtime availability, grants, instrument admission, and terminal FountainStore evidence must be observed separately. MIDI2 IDL, FCIS-KIT executable instruments, FountainStore format and Stripe's provider API retain independent owners. The complete system is prerequisite-free: a clean installation initializes its own Store, vault, owner and local UI; any existing-instance import is optional and governed by FCIS-SYSTEM.json. Version 0.5.0 adds the FCIS-owned Skill management and licensed distribution target. All new operations are specified only; the existing 0.4.0 runtime remains an independent accepted predecessor. Commercial operations are phase two. Version 0.5.1 clarifies only the read-only pairing-status Origin check for a same-origin browser; no mutation or grant authority changes. Version 0.5.2 corrects the two specified-only channel-contact responses to the existing signed channel receipt; contact is not admission, session establishment or a host.describe result. Version 0.6.0 specifies owner-native conversation custody and the subscription-only reasoning-client boundary. The new routes are target-only and make no provider entitlement or production claim. Version 0.7.0 adds optional situated domain binding to existing owner reasoning turns. No new HTTP operation, inference entitlement or execution grant.

get.summary: Discover issuer-enrolled Hosts and current grant status
get.description: Use to identify signed issuer-known machines and the latest enrollment/admission states. This reads the issuer's FountainStore projection; it does not contact the Host, verify reachability, enumerate installed instruments, authorize an MCP client, or execute a tool. The configured issuer execution target is not a separately enrolled machine. An admission marked verified concerns the existing narrow Host grant, not per-client callability. Select describeSelectedHost for a separate, correlated read-only Host job.

For draft create receipt.subjectId is the draftId; for admission it is releaseId; for offer release it is offerId; for review/withdraw/revoke it is the changed object's exact ID. recordRevision is that object's committed revision. A verified receipt remains independently readable via the corresponding protected resource, with audit references.

Provider checkout is hosted; no live charges authorized, no UI redirect proof. Refunds are separate approved instrument actions, entitlement changes only under accepted terms and reconciled receipts.
